task: Write a Ken program that computes the total revenue (`qty` × `price`) for every month, then outputs the 3 entries with the largest value (descending), one per line in the format `month: X USD`.
program: csv orders.csv set rev [ qty mul price ] set month [ date slice 0 7 ] by month [ each rev sum round 2 ] top 3 map [ fmt "{0}: {1} USD" ] print

task: Write a Ken program that determines the average number of nights (`nights`) per booking for every city, considering only bookings from the month `2026-03`, then prints the 3 entries with the largest value (descending), one per line in the format `city: average` (first print the text `Summary:`).
program:

"Summary:" print o where booked has 2026-03 by city [ each nights mean round 2 ] top 3 map [ fmt "{0}: {1}" ] print

task: Write a Ken program that computes, for each city, the percentage of bookings with outcome `stayed` among all bookings of that city, rounded to 1 decimal place, and then displays the 4 entries with the smallest value (ascending), one per line in the format `city: X%`.
program: csv bookings.csv by city [ as part part count as n part where outcome eq stayed count div n mul 100 round 1 ] pairs sort 1 first 4 map [ fmt "{0}: {1}%" ] print
